# Struer

Struer is a Danish municipality (kommune) named in the AFDK 2024 report as part of "Sundhedsklynge Kommune Struer" [^src1]. It is mentioned once in the corpus, in a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse) of the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark), which is administered by Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram [^src1]. That chapter includes a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters ("sundhedsklynger") participating in the AFDK program, and Struer is listed as the municipality belonging to one such cluster [^src1]. No further details about Struer's role, population, or activities are provided in the corpus.
